issues.description: The problem statement refers to an error-detection function named _detect_errors, but the template and solution use detect_errors. This name mismatch between the specification and the provided code/tests can confuse students about which function to implement and which name the tests expect.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the function name consistent across the problem statement, template, and tests. Either update problem_statement.md to reference detect_errors (preferred), or rename the template/solution functions to _detect_errors and update tests accordingly. Ensure the documented signature and semantics (return 1 for no error) remain the same.

issues.description: The problem statement asks students to implement a function named _detect_errors, but both the template and the reference solution define/expect a function named detect_errors (no leading underscore). This naming mismatch can confuse students about which function to implement and which name the tests will import/execute.
issues.suggestedFix: Use a single consistent name across artifacts. Rename the function reference in problem_statement.md from _detect_errors to detect_errors (or change the template/solution to _detect_errors). Prefer detect_errors (no underscore) to match the template and solution.
